sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Reduces the Cost of all enemies by 20.
-Cost reduction effect boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Reduces the action speed of all enemy NPCs by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Reduces the Cost recovery speed of all enemies by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Applies Awakening standby mode (activates Awakening for 60 seconds when HP drops below 60%) to all allies.
-Increases the Ability Power of all allies' time Unison damage by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Casts resurrection on your character.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000

[Additional Unison Effect] Casts Frenzy (nullifies debuffs and status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking) on all allied Soldiers and Rooks for 60 seconds.

Mortal Sin of Envy Revere or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
